summary: Iteration 6 verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 9/9 PASSED: /api/fridge/recipe empty→400 and marco→valid JSON {title,time,kcal,ingredients,steps}; /api/checkins/measurements partial save (vita+braccia only) + GET history returns 85.5/34, all-empty→400; /api/summary/weekly shape with weekStart,isSunday,weight,water,meals,calories; /api/cron/weekly 401 without auth, 401 with wrong Bearer, 200 with WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET and idempotent via X-Webhook-Id (duplicate:true on retry); /api/meals/eaten GET→POST (Martedì)→fridge dedup via LLM→DELETE lifecycle on marco. Frontend Playwright (marco@test.it): Tab Riepilogo renders summary-weight '+0.2 kg da 78.1 a 78.3', summary-meals '1/41 2% del piano', summary-calories '1100 kcal · piano 600 · foto 500 · previste 20300', summary-water '1.3 bicch./g obiettivo 1/7', summary-tip visible. Tab Peso: measurements-card visible, btn-save-measures disabled with empty inputs, enabled after filling input-measure-vita only, POST succeeds (peso rimane obbligatorio solo per peso, misure facoltative). Tab Frigo: btn-fridge-recipe genera fridge-recipe 'Frittata veloce con spinaci e bresaola · 15 min · 288 kcal · P32 C5 G16' usando solo ingredienti del frigo. Tab Piano Martedì: click btn-meal-eaten-colazione → '✓ Mangiato', LLM scala frigo (avena 500→440 g, verificato via GET /profile), persistenza dopo reload, re-click toglie e DELETE conferma. Regressione: shopping/recipes/water/mood/calendar/photo/supplements/profile aprono senza errori JS (solo i 401 benigni di /api/files già noti).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/profile does $set over the full ProfileIn dump — partial updates wipe unspecified fields (age/weight/goals went to null when a test posted only fridgeItems). Consider changing to merge semantics (only $set keys explicitly provided in request body via model_dump(exclude_unset=True)) to make the API safer for partial updates from both tests and future frontend code.

server.py /api/checkins/measurements POST filters out zero/falsy values with `if v` — a legitimate measurement of 0 (unlikely but possible for edge inputs) would be dropped. Low risk but use `if v is not None` instead.

server.py /api/meals/eaten POST does not persist the removed/updated fridge list atomically with the eaten record — if the LLM dedup call fails after the eaten doc is inserted, the eaten mark survives but fridge is unchanged (no rollback). Acceptable for MVP but consider wrapping in a try/except that rolls back the eaten insert on dedup failure, or at least surfaces the error to the client.
server.py /api/cron/weekly: cron_runs document uses the X-Webhook-Id as _id without TTL; the collection will grow unbounded over time. Consider a TTL index of 7-30 days on created_at.

server.py /api/fridge/recipe does not persist the generated recipe anywhere — if the user leaves the tab the recipe is lost and must be regenerated via another LLM call. Consider caching last recipe on the profile or returning a short list of saved quick recipes.

MealPlanViewer.toggleEaten: during the ~10-30s LLM fridge dedup, only the single clicked button is disabled via eatingId; the user can still navigate away and the toast with removed items may fire on an unmounted component. Add a loading hint on the day/meal and/or an AbortController.

rca of the issue: No bugs blocking functionality. Only a self-inflicted test hazard: posting a partial ProfileIn wiped marco's profile because PUT /api/profile uses $set with the full model dump (fields default to None). Reproduction: `PUT /api/profile {"fridgeItems": [...]}` → age/sex/weight/height/goals become null → next GET /api/profile returns age=null → frontend Dashboard useEffect navigates to /onboarding. Mitigation applied in-run: GET then PUT with {**prof, 'fridgeItems': ORIG} to merge, and marco's profile restored manually with age 28, M, 80 kg, 180 cm, goals ['massa'], etc. The test file is now using the merge pattern. Longer-term fix recommended for the main agent in critical_code_review_comments[0].
